title: Plants vs. Zombies (Sunflower Edition)
titleZh: 植物大战僵尸（向日葵版）
statementMd:
## 题目描述

Alice has recently become fascinated with Plants vs. Zombies (Sunflower Edition).

There are **two** types of sunflowers: the $i$-th type requires $p_i$ sun to plant and generates $q_i$ sun per round.

Initially, you have $s$ sun.

At the beginning of each round, you can buy and plant **each type** of sunflower **at most once**. At the end of each round, you will get all the sun generated by your sunflowers planted in this and previous rounds.

Assuming you can plant an unlimited number of sunflowers, calculate the maximum amount of sun you can have after $n$ rounds.

## 输入格式

The first line contains two integers $s$ and $n$ ($1 \leq s, n \leq 2 \times 10^7$), representing the initial amount of sun you have and the number of rounds the game will be played.\
The second line contains two integers $p_1$ and $q_1$ ($1 \leq p_1, q_1 \leq 1023$), describing the attributes of the first type of sunflower.\
The third line contains two integers $p_2$ and $q_2$ ($1 \leq p_2, q_2 \leq 1023$), describing the attributes of the second type of sunflower.

## 输出格式

Output a single integer, which is the maximum amount of sun you can have after $n$ rounds.

## 说明

In the first sample test case, Alice starts with $75$ sun and has $3$ rounds to plant sunflowers. Here is the optimal strategy:In the first round, spend $50 + 25 = 75$ sun to plant both types of sunflowers. At the end of the round, $25 + 15 = 40$ sun would be generated.In the second round, spend $25$ sun to plant the second type of sunflower and keep $40 - 25 = 15$ sun. At the end of the round, $25 + 15 + 15 = 55$ sun would be generated, and your sun would increase to $15 + 55 = 70$.In the third round, do not buy new sunflowers. After collecting $55$ sun for this round, you would have $70 + 55 = 125$ sun.
statementZhMd:
## 题目描述

Alice 最近迷上了《植物大战僵尸（向日葵版）》。

向日葵共有 **两种**：第 $i$ 种向日葵需要 $p_i$ 点阳光才能种植，并且每轮产生 $q_i$ 点阳光。

初始时，你拥有 $s$ 点阳光。

在每轮开始时，你**每种**向日葵**至多购买并种植一次**。在每轮结束时，你将获得你的向日葵（包括本轮及之前轮次种植的）产生的所有阳光。

假设你可以种植无限多株向日葵，请计算 $n$ 轮之后你最多能拥有多少阳光。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 $s$ 和 $n$（$1 \leq s, n \leq 2 \times 10^7$），表示你初始拥有的阳光数量以及游戏进行的轮数。\
第二行包含两个整数 $p_1$ 和 $q_1$（$1 \leq p_1, q_1 \leq 1023$），描述第一种向日葵的属性。\
第三行包含两个整数 $p_2$ 和 $q_2$（$1 \leq p_2, q_2 \leq 1023$），描述第二种向日葵的属性。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数，表示 $n$ 轮之后你最多能拥有的阳光数量。

## 说明

在第一个样例测试点中，Alice 初始拥有 $75$ 点阳光，游戏共进行 $3$ 轮。最优策略如下：第一轮，花费 $50 + 25 = 75$ 点阳光种植两种向日葵，本轮结束时会产生 $25 + 15 = 40$ 点阳光。第二轮，花费 $25$ 点阳光种植第二种向日葵，并保留 $40 - 25 = 15$ 点阳光，本轮结束时会产生 $25 + 15 + 15 = 55$ 点阳光，你的阳光将增加到 $15 + 55 = 70$ 点。第三轮，不购买新的向日葵，收取本轮的 $55$ 点阳光后，你将拥有 $70 + 55 = 125$ 点阳光。
